translations.text: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: “I will return to Jerusalem with compassion, and my house will be rebuilt in it,” says the Lord Almighty, “and a measuring line will again be stretched out over Jerusalem.”
And the angel who spoke within me said to me, “Cry out, saying: ‘The cities will again overflow with good things, and the Lord will again have mercy on Zion and love Jerusalem.’”
“For the stone that I placed before Joshua—on that one stone are seven eyes. And look, I will dig a pit,” says the Lord Almighty, “and I will overcome all the injustice of that land in a single day.”
“The hands of Zerubbabel laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will complete it. And you will know that the Lord Almighty sent me to you.”
“For, Judah, I have bent you for myself as a bow; I have filled Ephraim. And I will raise up your sons, Zion, against the sons of [?], and I will make them strong like a warrior’s sword.”
And that day is known to the Lord. It is neither day nor night, and at evening light will shine.
And they will live in it and will no longer be under a curse, and [?] will be inhabited securely [?].
